{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {df['biomarker_baseline'].eq(-999).sum()}")

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()}")

# Check the distribution of sample_seq per patient_id
sample_seq_counts = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(f"Number of patients with multiple sample_seq: {sample_seq_counts[sample_seq_counts > 1].count()}")"}
